+"""Disaggregated prefill (NIXL) under simulated execution.
+
+The connectors here are the real pull- and push-mode NIXL connectors with a
+simulated worker side, which moves no data and needs no NIXL: the scheduler
+side, leases and kv_transfer_params are the real ones. Engines in one process
+(`vllm.v1.worker.simulated.disaggregated`) find each other's workers by engine
+id; served instances book transfers over ZMQ at ports derived from the
+prefill instance's side-channel port.
+"""
+
+import heapq
+import math
+import threading
+import weakref
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+import torch
+import zmq
+
+from vllm import envs
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.utils import TransferTopology
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.base import (
+    KVConnectorTransferResults,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.connector import (
+    NixlPullConnector as RealNixlPullConnector,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.connector import (
+    NixlPushConnector as RealNixlPushConnector,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.metadata import (
+    NixlConnectorMetadata,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.tp_mapping import (
+    TPMapping,
+    compute_tp_mapping,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.utils import (
+    get_base_request_id,
+    get_representative_spec_type,
+    kv_lease_extension,
+    side_channel_port,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.offloading.config import (
+    group_kv_bytes_per_block,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import (
+    get_pp_group,
+    get_tp_group,
+    model_parallel_is_initialized,
+)
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.utils.network_utils import make_zmq_path
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import KVCacheConfig
+from vllm.v1.worker.simulated.kv_transfer import PostCost, read_runs
+from vllm.v1.worker.simulated.timing import Clock, RealClock
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.v1.worker.simulated.kv_transfer import TransferRate
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# Simulated NIXL workers of the engines in this process, by engine id.
+_workers: "weakref.WeakValueDictionary[str, SimulatedNixlWorker]" = (
+    weakref.WeakValueDictionary()
+)
+
+
+def simulated_nixl_worker(engine_id: str) -> "SimulatedNixlWorker":
+    """The simulated NIXL worker of an engine in this process."""
+    return _workers[engine_id]
+
+
+_BOOKING_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000
+_BOOKING_PORT_OFFSET = 10_000
+# Larger than the side-channel port gaps between DP ranks and P/D instances.
+_BOOKING_PORT_STRIDE = 1000
+
+
+def _rank_port(side_channel_port: int, rank: int) -> int:
+    """The booking port of served rank `pp_rank * tp_size + tp_rank`."""
+    return side_channel_port + _BOOKING_PORT_OFFSET + _BOOKING_PORT_STRIDE * rank
+
+
+def _warn_layout(req_id: str, prefill_tp: int, decode_tp: int) -> None:
+    logger.warning(
+        "Failing %s: prefill tensor parallelism %d, decode %d.",
+        req_id,
+        prefill_tp,
+        decode_tp,
+    )
+
+
+def _is_finite(*values: Any) -> bool:
+    return all(
+        isinstance(v, int | float) and math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in values
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass(order=True)
+class _Event:
+    time: float
+    req_id: str = field(compare=False)
+
+
+class SimulatedNixlWorker:
+    """The pull-mode NIXL worker of one engine, as a timing model.
+
+    Each decode rank reads from the prefill ranks the real TP mapping assigns
+    it; a request's reads run concurrently, and reads of different requests
+    queue on each rank's link. A prefill rank frees a request's blocks once
+    all its readers have notified it. Leases never expire, since heartbeats
+    run on the wall clock: a booking lost to an unresponsive prefill rank
+    holds its blocks."""
+
+    # Whether a prefill instance may use pipeline parallelism.
+    supports_pp = False
+
+    # Attributes the NixlConnector reads off its worker.
+    pcp_rank = 0
+    pcp_dcp_sharded = False
+    use_host_buffer = False
+    copy_blocks = None
+    xfer_handshake_metadata = None
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, engine_id: str, kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig
+    ):
+        assert vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None
+        self.tp_rank, self.tp_size = 0, 1
+        self.pp_rank, self.pp_size = 0, 1
+        if model_parallel_is_initialized():
+            self.tp_rank = get_tp_group().rank_in_group
+            self.tp_size = get_tp_group().world_size
+            self.pp_rank = get_pp_group().rank_in_group
+            self.pp_size = get_pp_group().world_size
+        self.engine_id = engine_id
+        self.is_producer = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer
+        if self.pp_size > 1 and not (self.supports_pp and self.is_producer):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Simulated disaggregated prefill supports pipeline parallelism "
+                "only on prefill instances of the NixlPushConnector."
+            )
+        self.use_mla = vllm_config.model_config.use_mla
+        self.num_kv_heads = vllm_config.model_config.get_total_num_kv_heads()
+        self.block_size = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+        self._group_spec_types = tuple(
+            get_representative_spec_type(g.kv_cache_spec)
+            for g in kv_cache_config.transfer_groups
+        )
+        self.side_channel_port = side_channel_port(vllm_config.parallel_config)
+        # Per transfer group, in the order of ReqMeta.local_block_ids.
+        groups = kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups
+        self.bytes_per_block = [
+            group_kv_bytes_per_block(groups[group_id])
+            for group_id in kv_cache_config.transfer_group_ids
+        ]
+        self.clock: Clock | None = None
+        self.rate: TransferRate | None = None
+        self.post = PostCost()
+        self.link_free_at = 0.0
+        # Decode side: reads in flight, and reads that could not be booked.
+        self._recving: list[_Event] = []
+        self._failed: set[str] = set()
+        # Prefill side: read notifications, and the requests whose blocks may
+        # still be read.
+        self._notifs: list[_Event] = []
+        self._reqs_to_process: set[str] = set()
+        # Notifications a request's blocks wait for, and those received.
+        self._expected: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._notified: dict[str, int] = {}
+        # When the link was free for each request being read, so that the
+        # reads of several decode ranks run concurrently.
+        self._read_floor: dict[str, float] = {}
+        # A served prefill rank books reads on a thread: guards its link and
+        # notifications.
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+        self._zmq: zmq.Context | None = None
+        self._peers: dict[tuple[str, int], zmq.Socket] = {}
+        # Bookings may be sent from the worker and the booking thread, one at
+        # a time per peer.
+        self._call_lock = threading.Lock()
+        self._peer_locks: dict[tuple[str, int], threading.Lock] = {}
+        self._server: threading.Thread | None = None
+        self._stop = threading.Event()
+        if engine_id in _workers:
+            raise ValueError(f"Two simulated engines share engine_id {engine_id}.")
+        _workers[engine_id] = self
+
+    def configure(
+        self, clock: Clock, rate: "TransferRate", post: PostCost | None = None
+    ) -> None:
+        self.clock = clock
+        self.rate = rate
+        self.post = post or PostCost()
+        if self._serves() and isinstance(clock, RealClock):
+            # A served instance: peers book transfers over ZMQ. Bind here, so
+            # that a taken port fails startup.
+            port = _rank_port(
+                self.side_channel_port, self.pp_rank * self.tp_size + self.tp_rank
+            )
+            if port > 65535:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Simulated NIXL booking port {port} is out of range; lower "
+                    "VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT."
+                )
+            sock = self._context().socket(zmq.REP)
+            sock.bind(make_zmq_path("tcp", envs.VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_HOST, port))
+            self._server = threading.Thread(
+                target=self._serve, args=(sock,), daemon=True, name="sim-nixl-bookings"
+            )
+            self._server.start()
+            logger.info(
+                "Simulated NIXL rank (pp %d, tp %d) takes bookings on port %d",
+                self.pp_rank,
+                self.tp_rank,
+                port,
+            )
+
+    def _serves(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether peers in other processes book transfers with this rank."""
+        return self.is_producer
+
+    def _context(self) -> zmq.Context:
+        if self._zmq is None:
+            self._zmq = zmq.Context()
+        return self._zmq
+
+    def _serve(self, sock: zmq.Socket) -> None:
+        try:
+            while not self._stop.is_set():
+                if not sock.poll(100):
+                    continue
+                reply = None
+                try:
+                    reply = self._handle(sock.recv_json())
+                except Exception:
+                    logger.warning("Rejected a KV transfer booking", exc_info=True)
+                # A REP socket must answer before it can receive again.
+                sock.send_json(reply)
+                self._after_reply()
+        finally:
+            sock.close(linger=0)
+
+    def _after_reply(self) -> None:
+        """Booking-thread work that must not delay a booking's answer."""
+
+    def _handle(self, message: Any) -> Any:
+        """Answer a booking from a peer in another process."""
+        op, req_id, num_bytes, delay_s, num_readers = message
+        if not (
+            op == "read"
+            and isinstance(req_id, str)
+            and isinstance(num_readers, int)
+            and num_readers >= 1
+            and _is_finite(num_bytes, delay_s)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"bad booking {message!r}")
+        assert self.clock is not None
+        now = self.clock.now()
+        return self.book_read(req_id, int(num_bytes), now + delay_s, num_readers) - now
+
+    def book_read(
+        self, req_id: str, num_bytes: int, earliest: float, num_readers: int = 1
+    ) -> float:
+        """Prefill side: book a read of `req_id`'s KV on this rank's link,
+        starting no earlier than `earliest`; returns when it ends. The blocks
+        are freed once all `num_readers` decode ranks have read."""
+        assert self.rate is not None
+        with self._lock:
+            floor = self._read_floor.setdefault(req_id, self.link_free_at)
+            end = earliest
+            if num_bytes:
+                end = max(earliest, floor) + self.rate.seconds(num_bytes)
+                self.link_free_at = max(self.link_free_at, end)
+            self._expected[req_id] = num_readers
+            heapq.heappush(self._notifs, _Event(end, req_id))
+        return end
+
+    @property
+    def _topology(self) -> TransferTopology:
+        """The local layout, all the real connector's rank mapping needs."""
+        return TransferTopology(
+            tp_rank=self.tp_rank,
+            tp_size=self.tp_size,
+            block_size=self.block_size,
+            engine_id=self.engine_id,
+            is_mla=self.use_mla,
+            is_mamba=False,
+            total_num_kv_heads=1 if self.use_mla else self.num_kv_heads,
+            attn_backends=[],
+        )
+
+    def _paired_ranks(self, remote_tp: int) -> list[int]:
+        """The remote ranks the real connector handshakes with; none if the
+        two tensor parallelisms do not divide each other."""
+        if max(remote_tp, self.tp_size) % min(remote_tp, self.tp_size):
+            return []
+        return self._topology.handshake_target_ranks(remote_tp)
+
+    def _mapping(self, remote_tp: int) -> TPMapping | None:
+        """The real connector's rank mapping to a remote instance of
+        `remote_tp` ranks; None for layouts it rejects."""
+        if not self._paired_ranks(remote_tp):
+            return None
+        if not self.use_mla and self.tp_size < remote_tp > self.num_kv_heads:
+            # Replicated remote heads (NixlBaseWorker's handshake check).
+            return None
+        return compute_tp_mapping(self._topology, remote_tp, self._group_spec_types)
+
+    def _book_remote_read(
+        self,
+        host: str,
+        port: int,
+        rank: int,
+        req_id: str,
+        num_bytes: int,
+        delay_s: float,
+        num_readers: int,
+    ) -> float | None:
+        """Book a read at a prefill rank in another process; returns how long
+        from now it ends, or None if the rank does not book it in time."""
+        answered, reply = self._call(
+            host, port, rank, ["read", req_id, num_bytes, delay_s, num_readers]
+        )
+        return float(reply) if answered and isinstance(reply, int | float) else None
+
+    def _call(
+        self, host: str, port: int, rank: int, message: list[Any]
+    ) -> tuple[bool, Any]:
+        """Send a booking to a rank in another process; returns whether it
+        answered in time, and its answer."""
+        address = (host, _rank_port(port, rank))
+        with self._call_lock:
+            peer_lock = self._peer_locks.setdefault(address, threading.Lock())
+        # One peer at a time per address: a slow peer delays no other.
+        with peer_lock:
+            sock = self._peers.pop(address, None)
+            if sock is None:
+                sock = self._context().socket(zmq.REQ)
+                sock.connect(make_zmq_path("tcp", *address))
+            answered, reply = False, None
+            try:
+                sock.send_json(message)
+                if sock.poll(_BOOKING_TIMEOUT_MS):
+                    answered, reply = True, sock.recv_json()
+                    self._peers[address] = sock
+            except Exception:
+                answered = False
+                logger.warning(
+                    "A KV transfer booking at %s:%d failed", *address, exc_info=True
+                )
+            if not answered:
+                # A REQ socket that got no answer cannot send again.
+                sock.close(linger=0)
+        return answered, reply
+
+    def register_kv_caches(self, kv_caches: dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def set_host_xfer_buffer_ops(self, copy_operation: Any) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def start_load_kv(self, metadata: NixlConnectorMetadata) -> None:
+        assert self.clock is not None and self.rate is not None
+        now = self.clock.now()
+        for req_id, meta in metadata.reqs_to_recv.items():
+            remote = meta.remote
+            assert remote is not None
+            # A full local prefix hit, or an aborted request, only notifies.
+            awaited = meta.awaiting_kvs or any(meta.local_block_ids)
+            num_bytes = sum(
+                len(ids) * size
+                for ids, size in zip(meta.local_block_ids, self.bytes_per_block)
+            )
+            # Read from the source ranks and notify the other paired ones; a
+            # rejected layout fails the request and only notifies.
+            mapping = self._mapping(meta.tp_size)
+            failed = mapping is None
+            if mapping is None:
+                _warn_layout(req_id, meta.tp_size, self.tp_size)
+            sources = mapping.all_source_ranks if mapping else ()
+            plan = [(r, r in sources) for r in self._paired_ranks(meta.tp_size)]
+            readers = mapping.local_consumers if mapping else 1
+            share = num_bytes // max(1, sum(reads for _, reads in plan))
+            producer = _workers.get(remote.engine_id)
+            if producer is None and not isinstance(self.clock, RealClock):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"No simulated engine {remote.engine_id} to read {req_id}'s "
+                    "KV from."
+                )
+            if (
+                (self.post.per_read_s or self.post.per_run_s)
+                and num_bytes
+                and not failed
+            ):
+                # Posting the reads holds the engine thread; they start once
+                # posted.
+                runs = read_runs(meta.local_block_ids, remote.block_ids)
+                self.clock.sleep_until(now + self.post.seconds(1, runs))
+                now = self.clock.now()
+            # A request's reads from several prefill ranks run concurrently;
+            # those of different requests one after another on this link.
+            earliest = max(now, self.link_free_at)
+            end = now
+            for rank, reads in plan:
+                read_bytes = share if reads and not failed else 0
+                start = earliest if read_bytes else now
+                if producer is not None:
+                    assert rank == 0, "in-process engines have one rank"
+                    read_end = producer.book_read(
+                        remote.request_id, read_bytes, start, readers
+                    )
+                else:
+                    duration = self._book_remote_read(
+                        remote.host,
+                        remote.port,
+                        rank,
+                        remote.request_id,
+                        read_bytes,
+                        start - now,
+                        readers,
+                    )
+                    if duration is None:
+                        failed = True
+                        continue
+                    read_end = now + duration
+                if read_bytes:
+                    self.link_free_at = max(self.link_free_at, read_end)
+                end = max(end, read_end)
+            if failed:
+                if awaited:
+                    self._failed.add(req_id)
+                continue
+            if awaited:
+                heapq.heappush(self._recving, _Event(end, req_id))
+
+        self._reqs_to_process.update(metadata.reqs_in_batch)
+        self._reqs_to_process.difference_update(metadata.reqs_not_processed)
+
+    def get_transfer_results(self) -> KVConnectorTransferResults:
+        assert self.clock is not None
+        now = self.clock.now()
+        done_recving = set()
+        while self._recving and self._recving[0].time <= now:
+            done_recving.add(heapq.heappop(self._recving).req_id)
+        # As the real worker, report failures as finished too.
+        failed, self._failed = self._failed, set()
+        done_recving |= failed
+        done_sending = set()
+        with self._lock:
+            while self._notifs and self._notifs[0].time <= now:
+                req_id = heapq.heappop(self._notifs).req_id
+                # As the real worker, drop reads of requests no longer tracked.
+                if req_id not in self._reqs_to_process:
+                    self._expected.pop(req_id, None)
+                    self._notified.pop(req_id, None)
+                    self._read_floor.pop(req_id, None)
+                    continue
+                self._notified[req_id] = self._notified.get(req_id, 0) + 1
+                if self._notified[req_id] >= self._expected.get(req_id, 1):
+                    self._reqs_to_process.remove(req_id)
+                    del self._notified[req_id]
+                    self._expected.pop(req_id, None)
+                    self._read_floor.pop(req_id, None)
+                    done_sending.add(req_id)
+        return KVConnectorTransferResults(
+            finished_sending=done_sending,
+            finished_recving=done_recving,
+            failed_recving=failed,
+        )
+
+    def get_finished(self) -> tuple[set[str], set[str]]:
+        results = self.get_transfer_results()
+        return results.finished_sending, results.finished_recving
+
+    def get_block_ids_with_load_errors(self) -> set[int]:
+        return set()
+
+    def get_kv_connector_stats(self) -> None:
+        return None
+
+    def next_completion(self) -> float | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            times = [q[0].time for q in (self._recving, self._notifs) if q]
+        return min(times, default=None)
+
+    def shutdown(self) -> None:
+        if _workers.get(self.engine_id) is self:
+            del _workers[self.engine_id]
+        self._stop.set()
+        if self._server is not None:
+            self._server.join()
+            self._server = None
+        for sock in self._peers.values():
+            sock.close(linger=0)
+        self._peers.clear()
+        if self._zmq is not None:
+            self._zmq.term()
+            self._zmq = None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Incoming:
+    """A decode rank's push-mode request: the writes it waits for (unknown
+    until its own scheduler step, as writes may arrive first), those
+    notified, and when the last ends."""
+
+    expected: int | None = None
+    count: int = 0
+    end: float = 0.0
+
+
+class SimulatedNixlPushWorker(SimulatedNixlWorker):
+    """The push-mode NIXL worker of one served engine, as a timing model.
+
+    Decode ranks register each scheduled request with their paired prefill
+    ranks in every pipeline stage, and forward heartbeats. A prefill rank
+    writes its share of a request's KV once the request is both finished and
+    registered; the decode rank has it after one write per prefill stage and
+    source rank. A request never registered (a full prefix hit) is freed when
+    its lease expires."""
+
+    supports_pp = True
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, engine_id: str, kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig
+    ):
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, engine_id, kv_cache_config)
+        assert vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None
+        self.lease_extension_s = kv_lease_extension(vllm_config.kv_transfer_config)
+        # Decode side, by request id.
+        self._incoming: dict[str, _Incoming] = {}
+        # Prefill side, by base request id: finished requests and
+        # registrations awaiting each other, and how many more copies of a
+        # matched registration other decode ranks still send. By request id:
+        # when its writes end, and the lease of an unregistered one.
+        self._finished: dict[str, tuple[str, list[int]]] = {}
+        self._registrations: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        self._registration_copies: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._late_registrations: dict[str, int] = {}
+        # Write notifications a registration started, sent once it is answered
+        # (booking thread only).
+        self._unsent_writes: list[tuple[str, int, int, str, float]] = []
+        self._writes_out: dict[str, float] = {}
+        self._leases: dict[str, float] = {}
+
+    def configure(
+        self, clock: Clock, rate: "TransferRate", post: PostCost | None = None
+    ) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(clock, RealClock):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "The simulated NixlPushConnector needs served instances."
+            )
+        # A decode rank posts no reads in push mode.
+        super().configure(clock, rate)
+
+    def _serves(self) -> bool:
+        return True
+
+    def _handle(self, message: Any) -> Any:
+        assert self.clock is not None
+        op = message[0]
+        if op == "reg":
+            _, reg = message
+            if not (
+                isinstance(reg["request_id"], str)
+                and isinstance(reg["host"], str)
+                and isinstance(reg["port"], int)
+                and isinstance(reg["tp_size"], int)
+                and reg["tp_size"] >= 1
+                and isinstance(reg["blocks"], list)
+                and all(isinstance(n, int) and n >= 0 for n in reg["blocks"])
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(f"bad registration {reg!r}")
+            base = get_base_request_id(reg["request_id"])
+            with self._lock:
+                late = self._late_registrations.get(base)
+                if late is not None:
+                    # Another decode rank's copy of a matched registration.
+                    if late <= 1:
+                        del self._late_registrations[base]
+                    else:
+                        self._late_registrations[base] = late - 1
+                    return True
+                if base in self._registrations:
+                    # Another decode rank's copy, before the request finished.
+                    self._registration_copies[base] += 1
+                    return True
+                self._registrations[base] = reg
+                self._registration_copies[base] = 1
+                self._unsent_writes += self._match(base)
+            return True
+        if op == "write":
+            _, req_id, duration = message
+            if not (isinstance(req_id, str) and _is_finite(duration)):
+                raise ValueError(f"bad write notification {message!r}")
+            with self._lock:
+                incoming = self._incoming.setdefault(req_id, _Incoming())
+                incoming.count += 1
+                incoming.end = max(incoming.end, self.clock.now() + duration)
+            return True
+        if op == "heartbeat":
+            _, req_ids = message
+            if not (
+                isinstance(req_ids, list) and all(isinstance(r, str) for r in req_ids)
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(f"bad heartbeat {message!r}")
+            bases = {get_base_request_id(r) for r in req_ids}
+            deadline = self.clock.now() + self.lease_extension_s
+            with self._lock:
+                for req_id, lease in self._leases.items():
+                    if get_base_request_id(req_id) in bases:
+                        self._leases[req_id] = max(lease, deadline)
+            return True
+        raise ValueError(f"unknown booking {op!r}")
+
+    def _after_reply(self) -> None:
+        writes, self._unsent_writes = self._unsent_writes, []
+        self._notify_writes(writes)
+
+    def _layout_supported(self, prefill_tp: int) -> bool:
+        """Whether every decode rank gets a write: no replicated decode heads."""
+        if not self._paired_ranks(prefill_tp):
+            return False
+        return self.use_mla or self.tp_size <= max(prefill_tp, self.num_kv_heads)
+
+    def _write_plan(self, decode_tp: int) -> list[tuple[int, float]]:
+        """The decode ranks this prefill rank writes to, each with its share of
+        the bytes, as the real push worker maps them; MLA's replicated latent
+        goes to every paired decode rank."""
+        mapping = self._mapping(decode_tp)
+        assert mapping is not None
+        if self.use_mla and self.tp_size < decode_tp:
+            return [(r, 1.0) for r in self._paired_ranks(decode_tp)]
+        ranks = mapping.all_source_ranks
+        return [(r, 1.0 if self.use_mla else 1.0 / len(ranks)) for r in ranks]
+
+    def _match(self, base: str) -> list[tuple[str, int, int, str, float]]:
+        """Under the lock: start the writes of a request that is both finished
+        and registered; returns the notifications to send."""
+        if base not in self._finished or base not in self._registrations:
+            return []
+        assert self.clock is not None and self.rate is not None
+        req_id, blocks = self._finished.pop(base)
+        reg = self._registrations.pop(base)
+        self._leases.pop(req_id, None)
+        # Copies of the registration from the other decode ranks this rank
+        # writes to that are still to come.
+        late = max(1, reg["tp_size"] // self.tp_size) - self._registration_copies.pop(
+            base, 1
+        )
+        if late > 0:
+            self._late_registrations[base] = late
+        num_bytes = sum(
+            min(n, m) * size
+            for n, m, size in zip(blocks, reg["blocks"], self.bytes_per_block)
+        )
+        now = self.clock.now()
+        start = max(now, self.link_free_at)
+        end = now
+        writes = []
+        for rank, share in self._write_plan(reg["tp_size"]):
+            write_end = start + self.rate.seconds(int(num_bytes * share))
+            end = max(end, write_end)
+            writes.append(
+                (reg["host"], reg["port"], rank, reg["request_id"], write_end - now)
+            )
+        self.link_free_at = max(self.link_free_at, end)
+        self._writes_out[req_id] = end
+        return writes
+
+    def _notify_writes(self, writes: list[tuple[str, int, int, str, float]]) -> None:
+        for host, port, rank, req_id, duration in writes:
+            answered, ok = self._call(host, port, rank, ["write", req_id, duration])
+            if not (answered and ok is True):
+                logger.warning("Decode rank %d did not take write of %s", rank, req_id)
+
+    def start_load_kv(self, metadata: NixlConnectorMetadata) -> None:
+        assert self.clock is not None
+        now = self.clock.now()
+        # Decode side: wait for one write per prefill stage and source rank.
+        failed = set()
+        for req_id, meta in metadata.reqs_to_recv.items():
+            if not self._layout_supported(meta.tp_size):
+                _warn_layout(req_id, meta.tp_size, self.tp_size)
+                failed.add(req_id)
+                continue
+            expected = max(1, meta.pp_size) * max(1, meta.tp_size // self.tp_size)
+            with self._lock:
+                self._incoming.setdefault(req_id, _Incoming()).expected = expected
+        for req_id, reg in metadata.push_registrations.items():
+            if req_id in failed:
+                continue
+            message = [
+                "reg",
+                {
+                    "request_id": req_id,
+                    "host": reg["decode_host"],
+                    "port": reg["decode_port"],
+                    "tp_size": reg["decode_tp_size"],
+                    "blocks": [len(ids) for ids in reg["local_block_ids"]],
+                },
+            ]
+            prefill_tp = reg["remote_tp_size"]
+            if not self._register(reg, prefill_tp, message):
+                # As after a failed handshake: fail the request.
+                failed.add(req_id)
+        with self._lock:
+            for req_id in failed:
+                self._incoming.pop(req_id, None)
+        self._failed |= failed
+        for heartbeat in metadata.heartbeat_by_engine.values():
+            message = ["heartbeat", sorted(heartbeat.req_ids)]
+            for pp_rank in range(heartbeat.pp_size):
+                for tp_rank in self._paired_ranks(heartbeat.tp_size):
+                    rank = pp_rank * heartbeat.tp_size + tp_rank
+                    self._call(heartbeat.host, heartbeat.port, rank, message)
+        # Prefill side: finished requests write once registered.
+        writes = []
+        with self._lock:
+            for req_id, deadline in metadata.reqs_to_send.items():
+                if req_id not in self._writes_out:
+                    # Deadlines are stamped with the scheduler's perf_counter.
+                    self._leases[req_id] = now + deadline - metadata.scheduler_clock
+            for req_id, block_ids in metadata.push_finished_blocks.items():
+                base = get_base_request_id(req_id)
+                self._finished[base] = (req_id, [len(ids) for ids in block_ids])
+                writes += self._match(base)
+        self._notify_writes(writes)
+
+    def _register(
+        self, reg: dict[str, Any], prefill_tp: int, message: list[Any]
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Register a request with every prefill stage's paired ranks."""
+        for pp_rank in range(reg["remote_pp_size"]):
+            for tp_rank in self._paired_ranks(prefill_tp):
+                answered, ok = self._call(
+                    reg["remote_host"],
+                    reg["remote_port"],
+                    pp_rank * prefill_tp + tp_rank,
+                    message,
+                )
+                if not (answered and ok is True):
+                    return False
+        return True
+
+    def get_transfer_results(self) -> KVConnectorTransferResults:
+        assert self.clock is not None
+        now = self.clock.now()
+        failed, self._failed = self._failed, set()
+        done_recving = set(failed)
+        done_sending = set()
+        with self._lock:
+            for req_id, incoming in list(self._incoming.items()):
+                if (
+                    incoming.expected is not None
+                    and incoming.count >= incoming.expected
+                    and incoming.end <= now
+                ):
+                    done_recving.add(req_id)
+                    del self._incoming[req_id]
+            for req_id, end in list(self._writes_out.items()):
+                if end <= now:
+                    done_sending.add(req_id)
+                    del self._writes_out[req_id]
+            for req_id, deadline in list(self._leases.items()):
+                if deadline <= now:
+                    done_sending.add(req_id)
+                    del self._leases[req_id]
+                    self._finished.pop(get_base_request_id(req_id), None)
+        return KVConnectorTransferResults(
+            finished_sending=done_sending,
+            finished_recving=done_recving,
+            failed_recving=failed,
+        )
+
+    def next_completion(self) -> float | None:
+        with self._lock:
+            times = [
+                i.end
+                for i in self._incoming.values()
+                if i.expected is not None and i.count >= i.expected
+            ]
+            times += self._writes_out.values()
+            times += self._leases.values()
+        return min(times, default=None)
+
+
+class NixlConnector(RealNixlPullConnector):
+    """The pull-mode NixlConnector with a simulated worker side."""
+
+    worker_cls = SimulatedNixlWorker  # type: ignore[assignment]
+
+    def set_xfer_handshake_metadata_pp_aware(self, metadata: dict) -> None:
+        """No handshake: simulated workers find or book each other directly."""
+
+
+class NixlPushConnector(RealNixlPushConnector):
+    """The NixlPushConnector with a simulated worker side."""
+
+    worker_cls = SimulatedNixlPushWorker  # type: ignore[assignment]
+
+    def set_xfer_handshake_metadata_pp_aware(self, metadata: dict) -> None:
+        """No handshake: simulated ranks book transfers at each other's ports."""
+
+
+NixlPullConnector = NixlConnector
+
+# The connector names (vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.factory)
+# whose worker side this module simulates.
+SIMULATED_CONNECTORS = ("NixlConnector", "NixlPullConnector", "NixlPushConnector")

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""KV connector transfers under simulated execution.
+
+A connector's scheduler side runs unmodified; on the worker, a simulation that
+moves no data completes each transfer after its modeled duration:
+`SimulatedOffloadingWorker` for CPU offloading, and `kv_nixl` for NIXL.
+"""
+
+from collections import deque
+from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Protocol
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.config.simulation import KVTransferTiming
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer import get_kv_transfer_group
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.utils import BlockIds
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.metadata import (
+    NixlConnectorMetadata,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.stats import (
+    NixlKVConnectorStats,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.offloading.common import (
+    OffloadingWorkerMetadata,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.offloading.config import (
+    get_offloading_group_ids,
+    group_kv_bytes_per_block,
+)
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.offloading_connector import (
+    OffloadingConnector,
+)
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import KVCacheConfig
+from vllm.v1.kv_offload.base import (
+    GPULoadStoreSpec,
+    LoadStoreSpec,
+    OffloadingWorker,
+    TransferResult,
+)
+from vllm.v1.outputs import KVConnectorOutput
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.kv_connector import ActiveKVConnector
+from vllm.v1.worker.simulated.timing import Clock, load_step_log
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# Fitted records this many times slower than predicted (a connection's setup,
+# or a NIXL agent's first postings to new memory) are outliers.
+_OUTLIER_FACTOR = 20
+_MAX_REFITS = 3
+# Rows whose units per count vary within this ratio have a single shape.
+_SAME_SHAPE_RATIO = 1.05
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PostCost:
+    """Host time a NIXL decode rank spends posting a step's reads, which holds
+    its engine thread: `per_read_s` per read plus `per_run_s` per run of
+    blocks that are consecutive on both instances. NIXL merges such a run
+    into one descriptor per KV cache region, so the second term grows as the
+    blocks a decode instance hands out scatter (once its cache has filled)."""
+
+    per_read_s: float = 0.0
+    per_run_s: float = 0.0
+
+    def seconds(self, num_reads: int, num_runs: int) -> float:
+        return num_reads * self.per_read_s + num_runs * self.per_run_s
+
+
+def read_runs(local_block_ids: BlockIds, remote_block_ids: BlockIds) -> int:
+    """Runs of blocks consecutive on both sides in one read, over its KV cache
+    groups. Remote blocks the decode instance already holds (a local prefix
+    hit) are not read: the last ones are paired with the local blocks."""
+    runs = 0
+    for local, remote in zip(local_block_ids, remote_block_ids):
+        if not local:
+            continue
+        remote = remote[len(remote) - len(local) :]
+        runs += 1 + sum(
+            1
+            for i in range(1, len(local))
+            if local[i] != local[i - 1] + 1 or remote[i] != remote[i - 1] + 1
+        )
+    return runs
+
+
+def nixl_reads(metadata: NixlConnectorMetadata) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """(reads, runs) a NIXL decode rank posts for a step's connector metadata."""
+    num_reads = num_runs = 0
+    for meta in metadata.reqs_to_recv.values():
+        if meta.remote is None or not any(meta.local_block_ids):
+            continue
+        num_reads += 1
+        num_runs += read_runs(meta.local_block_ids, meta.remote.block_ids)
+    return num_reads, num_runs
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TransferRate:
+    """Duration of one transfer: `latency_s + num_bytes / bytes_per_s`."""
+
+    latency_s: float
+    bytes_per_s: float
+
+    def seconds(self, num_bytes: int) -> float:
+        return self.latency_s + num_bytes / self.bytes_per_s
+
+
+def kv_transfer_rates(
+    timing: KVTransferTiming | str,
+) -> tuple[TransferRate, TransferRate | None]:
+    """(load, store) rates of `SimulationConfig.kv_transfer_timing`; store is
+    None if not given."""
+    if isinstance(timing, str):
+        return transfer_rates_from_log(timing)
+    assert timing.load_gbps is not None
+    load = TransferRate(timing.load_latency_us * 1e-6, timing.load_gbps * 1e9)
+    store = (
+        TransferRate(timing.store_latency_us * 1e-6, timing.store_gbps * 1e9)
+        if timing.store_gbps is not None
+        else None
+    )
+    return load, store
+
+
+def kv_post_cost(timing: KVTransferTiming | str) -> PostCost:
+    """NIXL read posting cost of `SimulationConfig.kv_transfer_timing`."""
+    if isinstance(timing, str):
+        return post_cost_from_log(timing)
+    return PostCost(timing.post_us_per_read * 1e-6, timing.post_us_per_run * 1e-6)
+
+
+def post_cost_from_log(path: str) -> PostCost:
+    """Least-squares `PostCost` of the read postings recorded in a step log,
+    without outliers."""
+    rows = [
+        (rec["kv_post"]["reads"], rec["kv_post"]["runs"], rec["kv_post"]["seconds"])
+        for rec in load_step_log(path, kind="kv_post")
+    ]
+    if not rows:
+        return PostCost()
+    a = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
+    # Both terms grow with reads + runs: screen out the slowest postings
+    # before the first fit, which they would otherwise dominate.
+    unit_s = a[:, 2] / (a[:, 0] + a[:, 1])
+    a = a[unit_s <= _OUTLIER_FACTOR * np.median(unit_s)]
+    a, per_read_s, per_run_s = _fit(a)
+    if _single_shape(a):
+        logger.warning(
+            "The reads recorded in %s are all alike, so the posting cost of "
+            "reads into scattered blocks is extrapolated. Record until the "
+            "decode instance's KV cache has filled and its blocks are reused.",
+            path,
+        )
+    cost = PostCost(per_read_s, per_run_s)
+    logger.info(
+        "NIXL read posting from %s: %.1f us per read + %.2f us per run (%d records)",
+        path,
+        per_read_s * 1e6,
+        per_run_s * 1e6,
+        len(rows),
+    )
+    return cost
+
+
+def _single_shape(a: np.ndarray) -> bool:
+    units_per_count = a[:, 1] / a[:, 0]
+    return units_per_count.max() <= _SAME_SHAPE_RATIO * units_per_count.min()
+
+
+def _lstsq(a: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    """Least-squares seconds per count and per unit of (count, units,
+    seconds) rows; all to the units if the two are not separable."""
+    (per_count, per_unit), *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(a[:, :2], a[:, 2], rcond=None)
+    if per_count < 0 or per_unit <= 0 or _single_shape(a):
+        per_count, per_unit = 0.0, a[:, 2].sum() / a[:, 1].sum()
+    return float(per_count), float(per_unit)
+
+
+def _fit(a: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float, float]:
+    """`_lstsq`, refitted without outliers; also returns the rows kept."""
+    per_count, per_unit = _lstsq(a)
+    for _ in range(_MAX_REFITS):
+        typical = a[:, 2] <= _OUTLIER_FACTOR * (
+            a[:, 0] * per_count + a[:, 1] * per_unit
+        )
+        if typical.all():
+            break
+        a = a[typical]
+        per_count, per_unit = _lstsq(a)
+    return a, per_count, per_unit
+
+
+def transfer_rates_from_log(path: str) -> tuple[TransferRate, TransferRate | None]:
+    """(load, store) rates fitted by least squares, without outliers, to the
+    transfers of a step log recorded with a KV connector; store is None if
+    none were recorded."""
+    rows: dict[str, list[tuple[float, float, float]]] = {"load": [], "store": []}
+    for rec in load_step_log(path, kind="kv_transfers"):
+        for direction, t in rec["kv_transfers"].items():
+            rows[direction].append((t["count"], t["bytes"], t["seconds"]))
+    rates: list[TransferRate | None] = []
+    for direction, direction_rows in rows.items():
+        a = np.asarray(direction_rows, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1, 3)
+        if not a[:, 1].any():
+            if direction == "store":
+                rates.append(None)
+                continue
+            raise ValueError(f"{path} has no recorded KV {direction}s")
+        # Bytes in GB keep the two columns on a similar scale.
+        a = a[a[:, 1] > 0] * [1.0, 1e-9, 1.0]
+        kept, latency_s, s_per_gb = _fit(a)
+        rate = TransferRate(latency_s, 1e9 / s_per_gb)
+        rates.append(rate)
+        logger.info(
+            "KV %ss from %s: %.1f us + %.2f GB/s (%d of %d steps)",
+            direction,
+            path,
+            rate.latency_s * 1e6,
+            rate.bytes_per_s * 1e-9,
+            len(kept),
+            len(direction_rows),
+        )
+    assert rates[0] is not None
+    return rates[0], rates[1]
+
+
+def completed_transfers(
+    kv_output: KVConnectorOutput | None,
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, float]] | None:
+    """The KV transfers that completed in a step, per direction, as a step log's
+    `kv_transfers` record holds them: CPU offloading's loads and stores, or a
+    NIXL decode instance's reads."""
+    if kv_output is None:
+        return None
+    meta = kv_output.kv_connector_worker_meta
+    stats = kv_output.kv_connector_stats
+    if isinstance(meta, OffloadingWorkerMetadata):
+        transfer_stats = meta.transfer_stats
+        transfers = {
+            direction: {"count": len(s.sizes), "bytes": s.bytes, "seconds": s.time}
+            for direction, s in (
+                ("load", transfer_stats.load),
+                ("store", transfer_stats.store),
+            )
+            if s.sizes
+        }
+    elif isinstance(stats, NixlKVConnectorStats) and stats.num_successful_transfers:
+        transfers = {
+            "load": {
+                "count": stats.num_successful_transfers,
+                "bytes": sum(stats.data["bytes_transferred"]),
+                "seconds": sum(stats.data["transfer_duration"]),
+            }
+        }
+    else:
+        return None
+    return transfers or None
+
+
+_LOAD, _STORE = 0, 1
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Transfer:
+    job_id: int
+    num_bytes: int
+    start: float
+    end: float
+
+
+class SimulatedOffloadingWorker(OffloadingWorker):
+    """Times KV transfers between device and host memory without moving data.
+
+    As with the CPU offloading worker's copy streams, each direction is a
+    serial queue, and a transfer starts only once the device has finished the
+    work enqueued before it was submitted (which writes the blocks a store
+    reads, or last reads the blocks a load overwrites)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        clock: Clock,
+        load: TransferRate,
+        store: TransferRate,
+        bytes_per_block: Sequence[int],
+        device_free_at: Callable[[], float],
+    ):
+        self.clock = clock
+        self.rates = (load, store)
+        # Per offloaded KV cache group, in the order of GPULoadStoreSpec groups.
+        self.bytes_per_block = bytes_per_block
+        self.device_free_at = device_free_at
+        # Indexed by _LOAD and _STORE.
+        self._queues: tuple[deque[_Transfer], deque[_Transfer]] = (deque(), deque())
+        self._free_at = [0.0, 0.0]
+
+    def _submit(self, direction: int, job_id: int, gpu_spec: GPULoadStoreSpec) -> bool:
+        num_bytes = sum(
+            n * b for n, b in zip(gpu_spec.group_sizes, self.bytes_per_block)
+        )
+        start = max(self.clock.now(), self.device_free_at(), self._free_at[direction])
+        end = start + self.rates[direction].seconds(num_bytes)
+        self._free_at[direction] = end
+        self._queues[direction].append(_Transfer(job_id, num_bytes, start, end))
+        return True
+
+    def submit_store(
+        self, job_id: int, src_spec: GPULoadStoreSpec, dst_spec: LoadStoreSpec
+    ) -> bool:
+        return self._submit(_STORE, job_id, src_spec)
+
+    def submit_load(
+        self, job_id: int, src_spec: LoadStoreSpec, dst_spec: GPULoadStoreSpec
+    ) -> bool:
+        return self._submit(_LOAD, job_id, dst_spec)
+
+    def get_finished(self) -> list[TransferResult]:
+        now = self.clock.now()
+        results = []
+        for queue in self._queues:
+            while queue and queue[0].end <= now:
+                t = queue.popleft()
+                results.append(
+                    TransferResult(
+                        job_id=t.job_id,
+                        success=True,
+                        transfer_size=t.num_bytes,
+                        transfer_time=t.end - t.start,
+                    )
+                )
+        return results
+
+    def wait(self, job_ids: set[int]) -> None:
+        ends = [t.end for queue in self._queues for t in queue if t.job_id in job_ids]
+        if ends:
+            self.clock.sleep_until(max(ends))
+
+    def next_completion(self) -> float | None:
+        ends = [queue[0].end for queue in self._queues if queue]
+        return min(ends, default=None)
+
+
+class SimulatedTransfers(Protocol):
+    def next_completion(self) -> float | None:
+        """When the next in-flight transfer completes, if any."""
+        ...
+
+
+class SimulatedKVConnector(ActiveKVConnector):
+    """The model runner's KV connector hooks, with the connector's
+    worker-side transfers simulated instead of registering KV caches."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, transfers: SimulatedTransfers):
+        self.transfers = transfers
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, {})
+
+    def register_kv_caches(self, kv_caches_dict: dict[str, torch.Tensor]) -> None:
+        connector = self.kv_connector
+        if isinstance(connector, OffloadingConnector):
+            assert connector.connector_worker is not None
+            assert isinstance(self.transfers, SimulatedOffloadingWorker)
+            connector.connector_worker.worker = self.transfers
+
+
+def simulated_kv_connector(
+    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+    kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig,
+    clock: Clock,
+    device_free_at: Callable[[], float],
+) -> SimulatedKVConnector:
+    from vllm.v1.worker.simulated.kv_nixl import (
+        NixlConnector,
+        NixlPushConnector,
+        SimulatedNixlWorker,
+    )
+
+    timing = vllm_config.simulation_config.kv_transfer_timing
+    if timing is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Simulated KV transfer needs simulation_config.kv_transfer_timing: "
+            "transfer bandwidths, or the path of a step log recorded with the "
+            "connector."
+        )
+    load, store = kv_transfer_rates(timing)
+    connector = get_kv_transfer_group()
+    transfers: SimulatedTransfers
+    if isinstance(connector, OffloadingConnector):
+        if store is None:
+            raise ValueError("KV offloading needs kv_transfer_timing store_gbps.")
+        groups = kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups
+        transfers = SimulatedOffloadingWorker(
+            clock,
+            load,
+            store,
+            bytes_per_block=[
+                group_kv_bytes_per_block(groups[group_id])
+                for group_id in get_offloading_group_ids(kv_cache_config)
+            ],
+            device_free_at=device_free_at,
+        )
+    elif isinstance(connector, NixlConnector | NixlPushConnector):
+        assert isinstance(connector.connector_worker, SimulatedNixlWorker)
+        transfers = connector.connector_worker
+        transfers.configure(clock, load, kv_post_cost(timing))
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Simulated execution supports the OffloadingConnector and the "
+            f"NixlConnector, not {type(connector).__name__}."
+        )
+    return SimulatedKVConnector(vllm_config, transfers)

+"""Model runner for simulated execution: the V2 runner's bookkeeping, with each
+step's forward and sampling replaced by its predicted time and trace or
+fallback tokens."""
+
+import dataclasses
+from contextlib import AbstractContextManager
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch

+

+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer import has_kv_transfer_group

+)

+)

+    StepLogWriter,
+    ZeroTimingProvider,
+    acceptance_rates_from_log,

+    build_step_descriptor,

+    empty_step_descriptor,
+    gather_dp_step,
+    get_timing_provider,
+    new_clock,
+    parallel_summary,
+    step_log_path,
+)
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.v1.core.sched.output import GrammarOutput, SchedulerOutput
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+_WARMUP_REQ_ID = "__simulated_warmup__"
+_WARMUP_PROMPT_LEN = 2
+# The draft token id the runner reports for drafts it does not propose.
+_PLACEHOLDER_DRAFT = -1
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _PendingStep:
+    input_batch: InputBatch

+    cost: StepCost
+    t_entry: float
+    t_start: float

+
+
+class SimulatedModelRunner(GPUModelRunner):
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, device: torch.device):
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, device)
+        sim = vllm_config.simulation_config
+        self.timing_provider = get_timing_provider(
+            sim.timing, dict(sim.timing_args), vllm_config
+        )
+        if sim.clock == "real":
+            self.clock: Clock = new_clock(sim.clock)
+        else:
+            clock = driven_engine_clock()
+            if clock is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"The {sim.clock} clock needs the engine core in the process "
+                    "of a driver reading the same clock; build the engine with "
+                    "vllm.v1.worker.simulated.offline.make_engine()."
+                )
+            self.clock = clock
+        log_path = step_log_path(vllm_config)
+        self.step_log = StepLogWriter(log_path) if log_path else None
+        self.fallback_token_id = sim.fallback_token_id

+        self._step_index = 0

+        self._stage_free_at = [0.0] * self.parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size
+        self._kv_transfers: SimulatedTransfers | None = None
+        self._last_output: SimulatedAsyncOutput | None = None
+        self._parallel = parallel_summary(vllm_config)
+        self._prompt_lens: dict[str, int] = {}

+        self._acceptance_rates = None

+        if spec is not None and spec.enable_adaptive_verification:

+                "Simulated execution does not support adaptive verification."
+            )

+            raise ValueError("Simulated execution does not support diffusion models.")

+                    "Simulated speculative decoding needs "
+                    "simulation_config.spec_acceptance_rates: per-position "
+                    "acceptance probabilities, or the path of a step log "
+                    "recorded with speculative decoding."
+                )
+            if isinstance(rates, str):

+            self._acceptance_rates = np.asarray(rates, dtype=np.float64)
+            logger.info("Draft acceptance rates by position: %s", rates)

+    def initialize_kv_cache_tensors(

+@dataclass

+    request_id: str

+            params.output_kind = RequestOutputKind.DELTA
+            add_token_request(engine, request_id, prompt, params)
+            timings[request_id] = RequestTiming(request_id, arrival, len(prompt))
+            if k + 1 < len(turns[i]):
+                in_flight[request_id] = (i, k, prompt)
+                outputs_so_far[request_id] = []
+        if not engine.has_unfinished_requests():
+            # Idle until the next arrival.
+            clock.sleep_until(t0 + frontend_latency_s + pending[0][0])
+            continue
+
+        # Lets an engine waiting only on its own transfers skip ahead.
+        clock.horizon = t0 + frontend_latency_s + pending[0][0] if pending else math.inf
+        before = clock.now()
+        outputs = engine.step()
+        t = clock.now() - t0
+        for out in outputs:
+            assert isinstance(out, RequestOutput)
+            timing = timings[out.request_id]
+            n = sum(len(c.token_ids) for c in out.outputs)
+            if n:
+                timing.num_output_tokens += n
+                timing.token_times.append(t)
+            if out.request_id in outputs_so_far:
+                outputs_so_far[out.request_id].extend(out.outputs[0].token_ids)
+            if out.finished:
+                timing.finish_time = t
+                if out.request_id in in_flight:
+                    # The next turn continues the conversation.
+                    i, k, prompt = in_flight.pop(out.request_id)
+                    output = outputs_so_far.pop(out.request_id)
+                    nxt = turns[i][k + 1]
+                    heapq.heappush(
+                        pending,
+                        (
+                            t + nxt.think_time,
+                            i,
+                            k + 1,
+                            prompt + output + nxt.new_token_ids,
+                        ),
+                    )
+
+        if outputs or clock.now() != before:
+            stalled = 0
+        else:
+            stalled += 1
+            if stalled > max_stalled_steps and isinstance(clock, VirtualClock):
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"No progress in {stalled} engine steps at simulated time "
+                    f"{t:.6f} s with {engine.get_num_unfinished_requests()} "
+                    "unfinished requests."
+                )
+
+    finished = [r.finish_time for r in timings.values() if r.finish_time is not None]
+    return SimulationResult(
+        requests=[timings[request_id] for ids in request_ids for request_id in ids],
+        duration=max(finished, default=0.0),
+        wall_time=time.perf_counter() - wall_start,
+    )
+
+
+def simulate(
+    engine_args: EngineArgs,
+    requests: Sequence[TimedRequest | TimedSession],
+    frontend_latency_s: float = 0.0,
+) -> SimulationResult:
+    """Build an in-process engine from `engine_args` and run `requests`
+    through it (see `run()`). Pass ``simulation_config={"simulate_forward":
+    True, "clock": "fast_forward", ...}`` for a run in simulated time."""
+    engine = make_engine(engine_args)
+    try:
+        return run(engine, requests, frontend_latency_s=frontend_latency_s)
+    finally:
+        engine.engine_core.shutdown()

+"""Record a real deployment's per-step timing in the simulator's step-log
+format."""
+
+import time
+from collections import deque
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer import (
+    get_kv_transfer_group,
+    has_kv_transfer_group,
+)

+)

+    NixlConnectorMetadata,

+from vllm.v1.worker.dp_utils import should_skip_dp_coordination

+    StepDescriptor,

+    accepted_in_step_order,
+    build_step_descriptor,
+    empty_step_descriptor,
+    gather_dp_step,

+    step_log_path,
+)

+logger = init_logger(__name__)

+
+@dataclass
+class _StepRecord:
+    start: torch.cuda.Event
+    end: torch.cuda.Event
+    descriptor: StepDescriptor
+    host_s: float
+    t_start: float
+    finished_req_ids: list[str]
+    # Set once the step's output is known.
+    resolved: bool = False
+    num_accepted: tuple[int, ...] | None = None
+
+
+class _RecordedOutput(AsyncModelRunnerOutput):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        inner: AsyncModelRunnerOutput,
+        record: _StepRecord,
+        worker: "RecordingWorker",
+    ):
+        self.inner = inner
+        self.record = record
+        self.worker = worker
+
+    def get_output(self) -> ModelRunnerOutput:
+        output = self.inner.get_output()
+        self.worker._resolve(self.record, output)
+        return output
+
+
+def _write_transfers(
+    writer: StepLogWriter, output: ModelRunnerOutput | AsyncModelRunnerOutput | None
+) -> None:
+    """Log the KV transfers this rank saw complete in the step."""
+    if isinstance(output, ModelRunnerOutput):
+        transfers = completed_transfers(output.kv_connector_output)
+        if transfers:
+            writer.write_transfers(transfers, time.perf_counter())
+
+
+def _num_accepted(
+    descriptor: StepDescriptor, output: ModelRunnerOutput
+) -> tuple[int, ...] | None:
+    """Accepted drafts per request of a speculative step, in descriptor order."""
+    sampled = output.sampled_token_ids
+    if not sampled or not any(r.num_spec_tokens for r in descriptor.requests):
+        return None
+    return accepted_in_step_order(
+        descriptor,
+        {r: max(len(sampled[i]) - 1, 0) for r, i in output.req_id_to_index.items()},
+    )
+
+
+class _TimedKVConnector(ActiveKVConnector):
+    """Times the reads a NIXL decode rank posts (see `PostCost`)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        kv_caches_dict: dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+        recorder: "RecordingWorker",
+    ):
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, kv_caches_dict)
+        self.recorder = recorder
+
+    def _start_load_kv(self) -> None:
+        metadata = self.kv_connector._get_connector_metadata()
+        assert isinstance(metadata, NixlConnectorMetadata)
+        num_reads, num_runs = nixl_reads(metadata)
+        if not num_reads:
+            return super()._start_load_kv()
+        self.recorder._posting_started()
+        t = time.perf_counter()
+        super()._start_load_kv()
+        self.recorder._posted(num_reads, num_runs, time.perf_counter() - t, t)
+
+
+class _RecordingModelRunner(GPUModelRunnerV2):
+    def __init__(
+        self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, device: torch.device, recorder: "RecordingWorker"
+    ):
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, device)
+        self.recorder = recorder
+
+    def _make_kv_connector(
+        self, kv_caches_dict: dict[str, torch.Tensor]
+    ) -> KVConnector:
+        if has_kv_transfer_group() and isinstance(
+            get_kv_transfer_group(), NixlPullConnector
+        ):
+            return _TimedKVConnector(self.vllm_config, kv_caches_dict, self.recorder)
+        return super()._make_kv_connector(kv_caches_dict)
+
+
+class RecordingWorker(Worker):
+    """GPU worker that logs each step's descriptor and measured timing."""
+
+    def init_device(self) -> None:
+        super().init_device()
+        self._pending: tuple[torch.cuda.Event, StepDescriptor, float, list[str]] | None
+        self._pending = None
+        # Records waiting for their step's output or device work, in order.
+        self._unwritten: deque[_StepRecord] = deque()
+        self._sampling = False
+        # The output rank of every DP replica describes its steps; under MoE
+        # data parallelism they also join each other's lockstep steps.
+        self._describes = is_output_rank()
+        self._joins_dp = self._describes and self.parallel_config.data_parallel_size > 1
+        log_path = step_log_path(self.vllm_config)
+        self._writer = StepLogWriter(log_path) if log_path else None
+        self._parallel = parallel_summary(self.vllm_config)
+        self._prompt_lens: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._step_index = 0
+        # A NIXL decode rank's read postings in the current step: when the
+        # first began (on the device stream) and how long they took.
+        self._post_event: torch.cuda.Event | None = None
+        self._post_s = 0.0
+        if self._writer is not None:
+            logger.info("Recording per-step timing to %s", log_path)
+
+    def _make_model_runner(self):  # type: ignore[override]
+        if self.use_v2_model_runner and not self.vllm_config.is_mm_encoder_only:
+            return _RecordingModelRunner(self.vllm_config, self.device, self)
+        return super()._make_model_runner()
+
+    def _posting_started(self) -> None:
+        # Postings at the end of a step (not synchronous loads before its
+        # forward) end its device work.
+        if self._sampling and self._post_event is None:
+            self._post_event = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+            self._post_event.record(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device))
+
+    def _posted(self, reads: int, runs: int, seconds: float, t: float) -> None:
+        if self._sampling:
+            self._post_s += seconds
+        if self._writer is not None:
+            self._writer.write_kv_post(reads, runs, seconds, t)
+
+    def execute_model(self, scheduler_output):  # type: ignore[override]
+        if self._unwritten:
+            self._write_completed()
+        if not self._describes:
+            return super().execute_model(scheduler_output)
+        descriptor = build_step_descriptor(
+            scheduler_output, self._prompt_lens, self._step_index, self._parallel
+        )
+        if scheduler_output.total_num_scheduled_tokens == 0:
+            output = super().execute_model(scheduler_output)
+            if self._writer is not None:
+                _write_transfers(self._writer, output)
+            return output
+        self._step_index += 1
+        if self._syncs_dp():
+            descriptor = gather_dp_step(descriptor)
+        if self._writer is not None:
+            start = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+            start.record(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device))
+            t_start = time.perf_counter()
+            self._pending = (
+                start,
+                descriptor,
+                t_start,
+                list(scheduler_output.finished_req_ids),
+            )
+        return super().execute_model(scheduler_output)
+
+    def _syncs_dp(self) -> bool:
+        return self._joins_dp and not should_skip_dp_coordination()
+
+    def execute_dummy_batch(self) -> None:
+        if self._syncs_dp():
+            gather_dp_step(empty_step_descriptor(self._step_index, self._parallel))
+        super().execute_dummy_batch()
+
+    def sample_tokens(self, grammar_output):  # type: ignore[override]
+        self._sampling = True
+        try:
+            output = super().sample_tokens(grammar_output)
+        finally:
+            self._sampling = False
+        pending, self._pending = self._pending, None
+        if pending is None or output is None:
+            return output
+        start, descriptor, t_start, finished = pending
+        end, self._post_event = self._post_event, None
+        if end is None:
+            end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+            end.record(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device))
+        record = _StepRecord(
+            start,
+            end,
+            descriptor,
+            host_s=time.perf_counter() - t_start - self._post_s,
+            t_start=t_start,
+            finished_req_ids=finished,
+        )
+        self._post_s = 0.0
+        self._unwritten.append(record)
+        if isinstance(output, AsyncModelRunnerOutput):
+            return _RecordedOutput(output, record, self)
+        self._resolve(record, output)
+        return output
+
+    def _resolve(self, record: _StepRecord, output: ModelRunnerOutput) -> None:
+        assert self._writer is not None
+        _write_transfers(self._writer, output)
+        record.num_accepted = _num_accepted(record.descriptor, output)
+        record.resolved = True
+        # Outputs are taken in step order: earlier steps still unresolved
+        # (warmup steps, whose outputs are dropped) never will be.
+        while self._unwritten[0] is not record and not self._unwritten[0].resolved:
+            self._unwritten.popleft()
+        self._write_completed()
+
+    def _write_completed(self, wait: bool = False) -> None:
+        """Write the records, in step order, whose device work has completed
+        (with `wait`, all whose output is known)."""
+        assert self._writer is not None
+        while self._unwritten and self._unwritten[0].resolved:
+            record = self._unwritten[0]
+            if wait:
+                record.end.synchronize()
+            elif not record.end.query():
+                return
+            self._unwritten.popleft()
+            device_s = record.start.elapsed_time(record.end) * 1e-3
+            self._writer.write(
+                record.descriptor,
+                StepCost(
+                    device_s=device_s,
+                    host_s=record.host_s,
+                    num_accepted=record.num_accepted,
+                ),
+                record.t_start,
+                record.t_start + max(device_s, record.host_s),
+                record.finished_req_ids,
+            )
+
+    def shutdown(self) -> None:
+        if getattr(self, "_writer", None) is not None:
+            self._write_completed(wait=True)
+        super().shutdown()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Step timing for simulated execution: a `TimingProvider` prices a
+`StepDescriptor` as a `StepCost`."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import contextlib
+import dataclasses
+import itertools
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import time
+from collections.abc import Iterator, Mapping
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Literal, Protocol, runtime_checkable
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.utils.import_utils import resolve_obj_by_qualname
+from vllm.v1.outputs import AsyncModelRunnerOutput, ModelRunnerOutput
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+    from vllm.v1.core.sched.output import SchedulerOutput
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# Recorded steps a k-NN lookup interpolates.
+_DEFAULT_KNN_K = 4
+# Relative error below which a smaller host-time fit wins a tie.
+_FIT_TIE_TOLERANCE = 1e-9
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SimRequestStep:
+    """One request's share of a simulated step."""
+
+    req_id: str
+    num_scheduled_tokens: int
+    """Tokens computed for this request in this step: a prefill chunk, or
+    ``1 + num_spec_tokens`` for decode."""
+    num_computed_tokens: int
+    """KV length before this step (prompt tokens already computed + outputs)."""
+    num_prompt_tokens: int
+    num_cached_tokens: int
+    """Prefix-cache hits credited at admission (0 for already-running reqs)."""
+    num_spec_tokens: int
+    is_prefill: bool
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ParallelSummary:
+    tensor_parallel_size: int = 1
+    pipeline_parallel_size: int = 1
+    data_parallel_size: int = 1
+
+
+def parallel_summary(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> ParallelSummary:
+    pc = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    return ParallelSummary(
+        tensor_parallel_size=pc.tensor_parallel_size,
+        pipeline_parallel_size=pc.pipeline_parallel_size,
+        data_parallel_size=pc.data_parallel_size,
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class StepDescriptor:
+    """Everything a timing model may need to price one scheduler step."""
+
+    step_index: int
+    requests: tuple[SimRequestStep, ...]
+    num_prefill_tokens: int
+    num_decode_tokens: int
+    num_prefill_reqs: int
+    num_decode_reqs: int
+    num_common_prefix_blocks: int
+    num_kv_tokens: int
+    """Sum over scheduled requests of KV length after this step."""
+    parallel: ParallelSummary = field(default_factory=ParallelSummary)
+
+    @property
+    def num_reqs(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.requests)
+
+    @property
+    def num_tokens(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_prefill_tokens + self.num_decode_tokens
+
+    @property
+    def is_decode_only(self) -> bool:
+        return self.num_prefill_reqs == 0
+
+    def replay_key(self) -> str:
+        """Batch composition key shared with recorded step logs."""
+        pairs = sorted(
+            (r.num_scheduled_tokens, r.num_computed_tokens) for r in self.requests
+        )
+        return json.dumps(pairs, separators=(",", ":"))
+
+    def to_json_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        d = asdict(self)
+        d["requests"] = [asdict(r) for r in self.requests]
+        return d
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_json_dict(cls, d: dict[str, Any]) -> StepDescriptor:
+        return cls(
+            **d
+            | {
+                "requests": tuple(SimRequestStep(**r) for r in d["requests"]),
+                "parallel": ParallelSummary(**d.get("parallel", {})),
+            }
+        )
+
+
+def accepted_in_step_order(
+    step: StepDescriptor, accepted: Mapping[str, int]
+) -> tuple[int, ...] | None:
+    """Accepted drafts of the step's requests, in its order; None for a joint
+    MoE-DP step, whose other ranks' requests are not in `accepted`."""
+    if not all(r.req_id in accepted for r in step.requests):
+        return None
+    return tuple(accepted[r.req_id] for r in step.requests)
+
+
+def build_step_descriptor(
+    scheduler_output: SchedulerOutput,
+    prompt_lens: dict[str, int],
+    step_index: int,
+    parallel: ParallelSummary,
+) -> StepDescriptor:
+    """Describe one scheduled step from the `SchedulerOutput`, as the simulated
+    runner and a recording worker both do. `prompt_lens` maps request
+    ids to prompt lengths across steps."""
+    for req_id in scheduler_output.finished_req_ids:
+        prompt_lens.pop(req_id, None)
+    num_scheduled = scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens
+    spec_tokens = scheduler_output.scheduled_spec_decode_tokens
+    computed: dict[str, int] = {}
+    cached_at_admission: dict[str, int] = {}
+    for req in scheduler_output.scheduled_new_reqs:
+        prompt_lens[req.req_id] = req.prompt_len
+        computed[req.req_id] = req.num_computed_tokens
+        cached_at_admission[req.req_id] = req.num_computed_tokens
+    cached = scheduler_output.scheduled_cached_reqs
+    for req_id, num_computed in zip(cached.req_ids, cached.num_computed_tokens):
+        computed[req_id] = num_computed
+
+    requests: list[SimRequestStep] = []
+    num_prefill_tokens = num_decode_tokens = 0
+    num_prefill_reqs = num_decode_reqs = 0
+    num_kv_tokens = 0
+    for req_id in sorted(num_scheduled):
+        scheduled = num_scheduled[req_id]
+        num_computed = computed.get(req_id, 0)
+        prompt_len = prompt_lens.get(req_id, 0)
+        is_prefill = num_computed < prompt_len
+        requests.append(
+            SimRequestStep(
+                req_id=req_id,
+                num_scheduled_tokens=scheduled,
+                num_computed_tokens=num_computed,
+                num_prompt_tokens=prompt_len,
+                num_cached_tokens=cached_at_admission.get(req_id, 0),
+                num_spec_tokens=len(spec_tokens.get(req_id, ())),
+                is_prefill=is_prefill,
+            )
+        )
+        if is_prefill:
+            num_prefill_tokens += scheduled
+            num_prefill_reqs += 1
+        else:
+            num_decode_tokens += scheduled
+            num_decode_reqs += 1
+        num_kv_tokens += num_computed + scheduled
+    common = scheduler_output.num_common_prefix_blocks
+    return StepDescriptor(
+        step_index=step_index,
+        requests=tuple(requests),
+        num_prefill_tokens=num_prefill_tokens,
+        num_decode_tokens=num_decode_tokens,
+        num_prefill_reqs=num_prefill_reqs,
+        num_decode_reqs=num_decode_reqs,
+        num_common_prefix_blocks=max(common) if common else 0,
+        num_kv_tokens=num_kv_tokens,
+        parallel=parallel,
+    )
+
+
+def empty_step_descriptor(step_index: int, parallel: ParallelSummary) -> StepDescriptor:
+    """A rank's share of a lockstep step in which it has no requests (an idle
+    data-parallel rank's dummy batch)."""
+    return StepDescriptor(step_index, (), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, parallel)
+
+
+def merge_dp_descriptors(descriptors: list[StepDescriptor]) -> StepDescriptor:
+    """All MoE data-parallel ranks' shares of one lockstep step, as one step.
+    Their forward passes meet in all-to-all collectives, so the step takes as
+    long as the whole joint batch dictates on every rank."""
+    own = descriptors[0]
+    return StepDescriptor(
+        step_index=own.step_index,
+        requests=tuple(
+            sorted((r for d in descriptors for r in d.requests), key=lambda r: r.req_id)
+        ),
+        num_prefill_tokens=sum(d.num_prefill_tokens for d in descriptors),
+        num_decode_tokens=sum(d.num_decode_tokens for d in descriptors),
+        num_prefill_reqs=sum(d.num_prefill_reqs for d in descriptors),
+        num_decode_reqs=sum(d.num_decode_reqs for d in descriptors),
+        num_common_prefix_blocks=max(d.num_common_prefix_blocks for d in descriptors),
+        num_kv_tokens=sum(d.num_kv_tokens for d in descriptors),
+        parallel=own.parallel,
+    )
+
+
+def gather_dp_step(descriptor: StepDescriptor) -> StepDescriptor:
+    """The joint step of all MoE data-parallel ranks. Must be called exactly
+    where the real runner synchronizes the DP ranks: every step that runs the
+    model, and every dummy batch of an idle rank."""
+    import torch.distributed as dist
+
+    from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_dp_group
+
+    group = get_dp_group()
+    gathered: list[StepDescriptor | None] = [None] * group.world_size
+    dist.all_gather_object(gathered, descriptor, group=group.cpu_group)
+    others = [d for i, d in enumerate(gathered) if i != group.rank_in_group]
+    return merge_dp_descriptors([descriptor, *others])  # type: ignore[list-item]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class StepCost:
+    """Predicted cost of one step: device time, and the host time the step's
+    `execute_model`/`sample_tokens` calls take."""
+
+    device_s: float
+    host_s: float = 0.0
+    num_accepted: tuple[int, ...] | None = None
+    """Per-request accepted draft tokens (speculative decoding), or None."""
+    breakdown: dict[str, float] | None = None
+    """Optional named components (e.g. per kernel class), for logging."""
+
+
+@runtime_checkable
+class TimingProvider(Protocol):
+    """Prices one simulated step. Implementations are constructed with the
+    engine configuration plus the user's `timing_args` as keyword arguments."""
+
+    def estimate(self, step: StepDescriptor) -> StepCost: ...
+
+
+class ZeroTimingProvider:
+    """Every step takes no device time (pure scheduler / KV-cache simulation)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
+        if kwargs:
+            raise ValueError(f"zero timing provider takes no arguments, got {kwargs}")
